adversary_model: An intake worker treats a completed custody/admission checklist or artifact locator as an admitted live response artifact.
hidden_trap_summary: Checklist readiness is not admission and cannot create response/intake/import state.
expected_safe_behavior: quarantine artifact until raw custody and authority pass
block response creation from checklist alone
unacceptable_behavior: treat artifact locator as live evidence
measurement_method: Check CACR, computed snapshot exclusion register, and failed-gate public summary requirements.
